implementation: One Instance-owned async credential executor, one native worker, max16 jobs including completed-but-not-returned reads; cancellations keep actual work owned.
Four owned mutation slots serialize intent, revocation and backend change; cancelled HTTP waiters cannot let later delete overtake earlier set.

FileVault private ACLs, bounded ciphertext/key metadata, durable replacement and canonical-name retirement before delete acknowledgement. Encrypted cleanup residue cannot resurrect lookup reference.

Instance credential requested/resolved audit, unique operation/kind, immutable/idempotent repository settlement, unknown intent count and owner-only bounded query. Unknown outcomes survive restart without replay.
HTTP and model share the same owned credential component; health and native-thread context propagation; shutdown retains database and instance lock on physical work.

Atomic durable file publication, no hardlink/special-file content access, bounded listing memory, read fingerprint visible to model and shell buffer truncation explicit.
Fresh close budget can retry an old coordinator that just returned false, without duplicating pending cleanup tasks.
Workbench own cache v14: bounded instance credential audit viewer and unknown-change count; four viewports/double theme covered.
